title: MK Suite — See what you can do

brand.name: MK Suite
facts: Design it. Approve it. Make it.
Know what changed on the farm.

intro.brief: Start instantly with oversized MAKE IT HAPPEN. Three real workflow fragments (waveform, timeline, document) snap into an MK SUITE identity. This is a product workflow film, with readable action and outcome. Keep 192 frames.
intro.music: Sub opening pulse, airy chord bloom; impacts at frames30 and120; ascending glass motif leads first portal.

outro.brief: MK SUITE / One suite. One monthly subscription. No price. Subscription concept; product availability varies. Free cores remain free. 120 frames.
outro.music: Resolved wide major-nine chord and restrained sparkling tail with fade last0.15s.

truthRules: Only sourced features from catalog and current local project READMEs; no invented results, user counts or guaranteed outcomes.
Subscription positioning requested by owner; billing not connected, no available-now claim; finale labels concept and availability variation.
Free cores remain free. No price per user's explicit selection.
Illustrative motion graphics, no claims of live application capture. No private data or real people.
All23 products get distinct visual scenes.21world preliminary plan superseded.
Illustrated workflows must show DEMO; never claim screen capture or live execution. Sample figures are explanatory, not measured product performance.
Every scene must visibly demonstrate an input, a control/action, and a result.
